about: A fixed, evenly spaced sample (about 320 per name, in time order) of the first hour of IEX trades on 2026-11-02 (8:30 to 9:30 AM Central) for stack C's 20-name live list, from Alpaca historical data (read-only). Rows are [name index, milliseconds after 14:30:00 UTC, price]. Used only to drive the volume rehearsal test.
